name: JOGEL
verdict: A sportswear brand of the Prime Sport company, the family business of founder Artur Movsesyan. Nothing found.
note: Russian sportswear brand founded in 2015; FC Rostov's technical sponsor and kit maker for 2026-27 (also kits the Russia national team and, per press, Spartak Moscow). Rating note: private company; chain ends at the Movsesyan family, no state stake found, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company (searched 3 Oct 2026).
